identities.name: Bourke Court House
identities.address: Richard Street at Oxley Street, Bourke, New South Wales, Australia

mapIdentity.scope: The courthouse exterior outline and enclosed garden court are tied to the named outdoor footprint, with pavilions and porch recesses inferred from archive photographs.

note: Original photographs show the open square corner turret, raised slate courtroom with paired hooded roof vents, semicircular upper windows, verandahs and scalloped courtyard walls. The state heritage register records the rough cast render over brick, face brick and slate.
